claims: As of April 2026, Honda is recalling over 440,000 Odyssey minivans model years 2018–2022.
The affected vehicles are 2018-2022 Honda Odyssey.
The defect is a software error in the Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) control unit.
The software error can cause side airbags to deploy without warning.
Side airbags can deploy when hitting strong impacts like potholes or speed bumps.
The defect causes side airbags to deploy unexpectedly.
Unexpected deployment of side airbags increases injury risk.
Dealers will update or replace the SRS computer software for free.
The recall follows numerous reports of injury related to the unexpected deployment.
The recall is separate from other recent Honda recalls involving fuel pumps, steering gears, or rear camera issues.
